title: Otzlab x Metapack: A perfume bottle suspended in a metal frame
summary: For the Otzlab fragrance, Metapack developed a set of packaging components combining stainless steel, polypropylene (PP), and resin. The design incorporates a fastening system that suspends the bottle vertically within a metal frame while allowing it to be easily removed. Based on the design provided by the brand, the development focused on a key technical challenge: securely suspending the bottle at the center of the frame while ensuring that it could be easily detached.
